D: A divorced couple team up to stop their daughter from marrying a man she just met in Bali.
P: Serve the mains when both families sit down together in Bali.
S: Chicken thighs marinated in turmeric, lemongrass and coconut milk, grilled on skewers until charred, with a lime and peanut sauce.
Seaweed farm nori crisps with sesame salt

Nori sheets sandwiched with rice paper, brushed with sesame oil, fried until shatteringly crisp and dusted with toasted sesame, chilli and salt. Brush 6 rice paper sheets lightly with water and press a nori sheet onto each. Cut into 5cm strips. Heat 3cm vegetable oil in a wok to 180C and fry a few strips at a time for 10 to 15 seconds until they puff and crisp. Drain on paper towel. Toast 2 tbsp sesame seeds in a dry pan and crush with 1 tsp salt and half a tsp chilli flakes. Brush the crisps with a little sesame oil and dust with the sesame salt.
David and Georgia's beer pong comeback
Prawn crackers fried in hot oil for a few seconds until they puff, drained and served with sweet chilli sauce.
M: dinner with Gede's seaweed farming family

Day-old rice fried hot with chicken, garlic, chilli and kecap manis until smoky, topped with a fried egg and cucumber. Stir-fry 400g diced chicken thighs with crushed garlic and chopped red chilli in a very hot wok. Add 4 cups cold cooked jasmine rice and 3 tbsp kecap manis and toss until smoky. Serve topped with a fried egg and cucumber slices.
Banana leaf snapper with sambal matah
the beach in Bali where Lily falls for Gede

Snapper fillets rubbed with turmeric, chilli, garlic and lime, grilled in banana leaves, topped with a raw lemongrass and eschalot sambal, with coconut rice. Pound 2 garlic cloves, 2 red chillies, 2cm turmeric and the juice of 1 lime into a paste and rub over 4 snapper fillets. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill or barbecue 10 minutes, turning once. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice with 200ml coconut milk and water. For the sambal, finely slice 4 eschalots, 2 lemongrass stalks, 2 chillies and 3 makrut lime leaves, mix with 3 tbsp oil, lime juice and salt. Spoon over the fish.
W: Black sticky rice soaked overnight, simmered with water and palm sugar until thick, topped with salted coconut cream.
K: David and Georgia's plan to stop the wedding

Coconut water and pineapple juice with lime and mint over ice. Fill tall glasses with ice and mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir and serve cold, watching the sun go down on a beach in Bali.
